description: This file defines the RssItem class, a simple data holder for individual RSS feed items, including attributes like title, link, and description, with corresponding constructors and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: RssItem
classes.description: A data container class for RSS feed items with title, link, and description properties.

methods.name: RssItem
methods.description: Default constructor initializing fields to empty strings.

methods.name: RssItem
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize the RSS item with specific title, link, and description.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the RSS item.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the RSS item.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns the link of the RSS item.

methods.description: Sets the link of the RSS item.

methods.name: setTitle
